verdict.rationale: Datadog's APM product (docs-23) covers tracing and stack traces are a standard part of Error Tracking within APM, and Watchdog (docs-16) provides anomaly/regression-style detection, but the evidence pack lacks specific documentation of an Error Tracking feature with issue grouping, deduplication, or release-based regression detection. missing for 10: dedicated Error Tracking docs describing issue grouping, release tagging, and regression detection; independent/community corroboration of this specific workflow.
